title: Which configurations need to change when upsizing a 6061 aluminium-tube annealing furnace?
summary: Compare chamber size, doors, heating zones and circulation together when selecting an aluminium-tube annealing furnace. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s 2022–2023 records for 6061 aluminium tubes include several new-furnace sizes and a 300 kW retrofit quotation. Configuration changes involve more than increased power. These documents support initial comparison, not a confirmed sequence of capacity expansions or completed modifications.
